touches.text: artifact: the one door a record of truth changes through, and the journal of who came through it (hash-chained, caller read from the kernel). WHY: errors are permanent in records of truth (Law 7), and the journal is what shows a record moved by hand. USERS: everyone who writes a record.
Lives in CairnCommons/tickets/ while staged; its trail migrates beside its code as that component's history while under way, and back to the commons after (Law 5).
Commit often. WHY: so we never wind up with stray files or incomplete work.
